name: combat
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make a 2x2 animation key-pose sheet of EXACT Ash Pikeman demon soldier in reference: red skin, two straight black horns, yellow eyes, jagged charcoal spiked plate armor, red torn skirt, long dark spear with broad jagged head glowing orange rune marks and pointed butt. Match serious crisp angular 2D cel shading. Four equal large cells, one full character per cell, transparent background, no labels or grid. Identical anatomical size, horn count, armor, proportions and spear in all cells. Full weapon and feet visible with generous margins. Face mostly right. Same camera. Render actual new body and limb poses, not translated copies. Weapons rigid and held with two correct hands.  Combat sheet: top-left anticipation: knees flex, torso twists back slightly, spear drawn back in both hands preparing short upward-diagonal thrust. Top-right attack impact: torso leans into controlled thrust toward upper right AND slightly into camera to foreshorten long spear so whole weapon fits; elbows extend, spear remains straight, tip high. Bottom-left recovery: torso returns upright, spear halfway back to diagonal guard, knees straighten. Bottom-right struck reaction: chest recoils backward, face grimaces, both hands still gripping spear diagonally upright, bent knees and planted feet. Keep face/armor exactly recognizable. No gore, no extra effects, no motion lines.

name: lifecycle
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make a 2x2 animation key-pose sheet of EXACT Ash Pikeman demon soldier in reference: red skin, two straight black horns, yellow eyes, jagged charcoal spiked plate armor, red torn skirt, long dark spear with broad jagged head glowing orange rune marks and pointed butt. Match serious crisp angular 2D cel shading. Four equal large cells, one full character per cell, transparent background, no labels or grid. Identical anatomical size, horn count, armor, proportions and spear in all cells. Full weapon and feet visible with generous margins. Face mostly right. Same camera. Render actual new body and limb poses, not translated copies. Weapons rigid and held with two correct hands.  Lifecycle sheet. Top-left wounded standing guard: shoulders slumped, knees a little bent, torso slightly hunched, grimace, using diagonal spear as support. Top-right summoning arrival: knees bent in a low but standing arrival stance with small compact ember wisps around feet, holds spear diagonal guard; character fully opaque. Bottom-left death buckle: one knee collapsing to ground, torso hunched, face anguished, spear slipping low diagonally across body. Bottom-right terminal dead pose: collapsed on side on ground, head down eyes closed, legs folded naturally, straight spear resting alongside body diagonal within cell. No gore. Death body remains recognizable same size even though shorter pose. Keep all parts inside each isolated cell; no overlap between cells; generous internal margin.
